description: Defines macros and inline functions for a memory FIFO implemented as a circular queue, supporting enqueue and dequeue operations with two API variants (value-type and pointer-type).
external_files: cpu_dmb() macro or function (likely from a platform-specific header)

methods.name: mfifo_enqueue_idx_get
methods.description: Non-destructive: Allocates buffer index from tail, used internally by API 1.

methods.name: mfifo_by_idx_enqueue
methods.description: Commits a buffer to the queue at a specified index, for API 2.

methods.name: mfifo_enqueue_get
methods.description: Non-destructive: Allocates buffer in limbo for API 1, returns index and pointer to buffer.

methods.name: mfifo_enqueue
methods.description: Atomically commits a previously allocated buffer index, completing enqueue for API 1.

methods.name: mfifo_avail_count_get
methods.description: Returns the number of available buffers in the queue.

methods.name: mfifo_dequeue_get
methods.description: Non-destructive peek at the head buffer for API 1.

methods.name: mfifo_dequeue_peek
methods.description: Non-destructive peek at the head buffer for API 2.

methods.name: mfifo_dequeue_iter_get
methods.description: Iterates over buffers in the queue, returning next buffer and updating index.

methods.name: mfifo_dequeue
methods.description: Dequeue the head buffer from the queue, updating the read index.
